About Cemantica

Cemantica is a single, scalable Customer Experience platform brought to you by CCXP professionals. 

Are you a good fit for our team? 

Find out more about our mission, values, certifications and global footprint.

We are experiencing high growth due to our innovative mind-set, multi-disciplinary skills and a beautiful platform that helps our global enterprise customers reach their business transformation goals.

Our Mission
Our Values
Download Brochure

Who will you be working with?

You will join a high-performing, collaborative and international team of experts who work together to serve and support our customers from major brands across multiple sectors and countries.

With headquarters in France, R&D in Israel, and satellite global locations across Europe and the United States; our team practice a balanced and dynamic approach to work with a combination of hybrid, office and remote working.

Our Leadership Team

Why work at Cemantica?

This is your chance to develop your career path in a modern, vibrant and innovative company. 


Cemantica is full of passion; our people are strongly committed to helping our customers to deliver the best Customer Experience. We love to work with each other and see how everyone contributes to the growth of Cemantica.

We believe that diversity fuels innovation and creativity. Our employee commitments drive our inclusive culture, ensuring that as an organization we continue to reflect the modern world we operate in, across race, gender, age, religion, identity and experience.

As our team is spread throughout the world, trust, empowerment and fun are how we bring success for our customers and each other.

Open Customer Experience positions

CX career opportunities are wide ranging. Our multi-disciplinary teams include CX Consultants, Customer Support, Quality Assurance, R&D, Product Development, UX-UI Designers, Account Managers, New Business Development and Marketing. Our flexible working approach means we offer full-time, part-time and freelance jobs.

You will find open positions below of Customer Experience jobs when we are recruiting, or you can send us your CV speculatively by completing the form.

Why are careers in CX exciting?

Careers in Customer Experience (CX) technology combine empathy, data and innovation. CX industry jobs are an exciting career where you actively make a difference while staying at the forefront of technological advancements such as Artificial Intelligence.

As a specialist within your chosen field of Customer Experience, you will directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and brand perception of our customers.

Let’s make this happen. Bring your Customer Experience strategy to life with Cemantica
